verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents an API versioning approach: a new endpoint version is released for each backwards-incompatible change, and endpoint references show v2/v3 versioned paths. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods or how long old versions stay supported. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, deprecation signalling (headers or changelog), and independent corroboration of how version transitions work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: A new version of an API endpoint is released whenever a new *backwards incompatible* change is released.
